[[Tohmahs Sukobehr]] is a [[Kourna]]n who resides in the vicinity of the [[Mahnkelon Waterworks]].

==Location==
*[[Kourna]]
**{{NPC location|The Floodplain of Mahnkelon}} (inside the waterworks)

==Dialogue==
:''"Ahai, [[Order of the Sunspears|Sunspears]]. Relax, I won't tell anyone I saw you here. It may not seem like it but many Kournans are sympathetic to your plight. The defeat at [[Gandara, the Moon Fortress|Gandara]] was a heavy blow to all [[Elona|Elonians]]."''

==Quotes==
:''"We are Elonians before we are Kournans."''

==Trivia==
*This NPC's name is likely a tribute to Tomas Schober, one of the [[Game credits#Guidebook Alpha Testers|Guidebook Alpha Testers]] for [[Nightfall]].
